changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.wallet_reconciliations ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, informed_balance numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, wallet_balance numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, difference numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, reason varchar(150) NOT NULL, id_wallet bigint NOT NULL, id_wallet_entry bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT wallet_reconciliations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT wallet_reconciliations_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT wallet_reconciliations_id_wallet_entry_key UNIQUE (id_wallet_entry), CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_reconciliations_on_difference CHECK (difference <> 0), CONSTRAINT fk_wallets_on_wallet_reconciliations FOREIGN KEY (id_wallet) REFERENCES registration.wallets (id), CONSTRAINT fk_wallet_entries_on_wallet_reconciliations FOREIGN KEY (id_wallet_entry) REFERENCES financial.wallet_entries (id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_wallet_reconciliations_on_wallet ON financial.wallet_reconciliations (id_wallet, created_on DESC, id DESC);
